fact: In 2023 the Cameroon-Gabon corridor was the busiest intra-CEMAC cross-border mobile transfer corridor through GIMAC, at 66.23% of such transactions by number and 52.48% by value; CEMAC mobile money received 7,421,924 international transfers worth CFA 557.35 billion.
title: Rapport d'activités annuel 2023: Rapport sur les services de paiement dans la CEMAC
publisher: Banque des États de l'Afrique Centrale, DSMP
